Generalization Guarantees for Data-Driven
Mechanism Design
Maria-Florina Balcan
Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA, USA

      Abstract
Many mechanisms including pricing mechanisms and auctions typically come with a variety of
tunable parameters which impact significantly their desired performance guarantees. Data-driven
mechanism design is a powerful approach for designing mechanisms, where these parameters are
tuned via machine learning based on data. In this talk I will discuss how techniques from machine
learning theory can be adapted and extended to analyze generalization guarantees of data-driven
mechanism design.
